## History

After running away from an abusive guardian, [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) hid in an old barn near the Ashdown home, where the Ashdown children discovered her, provided her with food, and heard her share her tragic history and unique views. She later joined [Grace](../character/grace.md), [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md), [Bess](../character/bess-carrow.md), and [Izzy](../character/izzy.md) in [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) to chew spruce gum and shared local gossip with them. During this outing, her fine new clothes and muff sparked initial envy from [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md), though [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) ultimately gave Mary her gum and complimented her muff after [Grace](../character/grace.md) panicked over news Mary brought about a killed rooster.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY STUBBS P4](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0004), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY STUBBS P14](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0014), [v5 CHAPTER V.
